name: findcheap-agent
description: Search Shopify Global Catalog and automatically discovered joined Awin Feeds, find verified deals, and monitor prices, promotions, and stock.

interface.shortDescription: Verified cards, pricing, coupons, and safe links.
interface.longDescription: FindCheap Agent is a Codex Plugin Agent. v0.10.1 uses the private Awin Feed List to automatically discover every joined US English Feed and adds hourly Awin Promotion synchronization for joined advertisers, including advertisers without Product Feeds. The Railway service validates publisher and merchant relationships, keeps source credentials private, and exposes bounded read-only product and promotion search. Shopify Global Catalog remains the general catalog source and fills eligible results. Node.js 24, evidence-aware matching, merchant trust, affiliate-neutral ranking, stable product selection, delivered-price rules, bounded provider normalization, and fail-closed schema handling remain in place. Authorized Chrome remains a bounded fallback after API search returns no usable product. The agent never checks out, reserves inventory, purchases, or pays.
defaultPrompt: Clear shopping request: call matching tool now. No Memory, repo scan, plan narration, or manual MCP launch.
